name: Mini coach
short: A small coach for group vacations, club tours and wedding shuttles.
summary: A small, air-conditioned coach with a driver and, for longer tours, an assistant, for group vacations, club tours and wedding guest shuttles.

features.title: One group, one plan
features.body: The whole party moves together, with a driver and an assistant who handles the luggage at each stop.

features.title: Microphone and reclining seats
features.body: Your guide can talk the route as you drive, and the seats recline for the longer stretches.

features.title: Shuttles on a timetable
features.body: For weddings and events we run fixed loops between hotels and venues, so guests never wait on the kerb.

included: Driver's meals and rooms on multi-day hires
A driver's assistant for luggage on tours

questions.q: Can the coach reach the hill country?
questions.a: Yes, on the main roads to Kandy, Nuwara Eliya and Ella. A few small estate roads are too narrow, and we plan around them.

questions.q: Can it run wedding shuttles all evening?
questions.a: Yes. Give us the venue, the hotels and the times, and we build a shuttle timetable with the driver on standby between runs.
